messages.每组填写名称、接收服务地址和认证方式。支持网页登录与 API 认证组合，各组凭据: Give each credential a name, service URL, and authentication method. Combine website logins and API keys; each credential is used only for its assigned service.
messages.最多8组；修改一组时可以保留其它组已保存的凭据。: Up to 8 credentials. Update one while keeping the others saved.
